findings.problem: Both theorems finish with the same argument. A relative index r divides 2^b and also divides a number s that is not divisible by 2. So r = 2^i, and i ≠ 0 would give 2 ∣ s, so r = 1. Both proofs spell this out as obtain ⟨i,-,hi⟩ := Nat.dvd_prime_pow, by_contra on i, dvd_pow_self, a ▸ rewrite, and rw [hi0, pow_zero]. The block is inlined again at lines 97-101 with different names (h1, h2). The same idiom appears in many other files in the repo, so a shared lemma has further uses.
findings.proposed_change: Add one arithmetic helper before both theorems. Statement: `theorem eq_one_of_dvd_two_pow_of_dvd_odd {r s b : ℕ} (hr : r ∣ 2 ^ b) (hrs : r ∣ s) (hs : ¬ 2 ∣ s) : r = 1`. Proof sketch: obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow Nat.prime_two).1 hr. If i = 0 then pow_zero closes the goal. Otherwise (dvd_pow_self 2 hne).trans hrs contradicts hs. Then in le_sup_of_relIndex replace lines 75-80 by `exact Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one.1 (eq_one_of_dvd_two_pow_of_dvd_odd h4 h3 hodd)`, since h4 : (T ⊔ N).relIndex K ∣ 2 ^ b, h3 : (T ⊔ N).relIndex K ∣ T.relIndex K, and hodd is the hypothesis. In le_of_normalizes_sylow replace lines 97-102 by `exact le_sup_left.trans (Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one.1 (eq_one_of_dvd_two_pow_of_dvd_odd h1 h2 hodd))`, with h1 : S.relIndex (U ⊔ S) ∣ 2 ^ (b + a), h2 : S.relIndex (U ⊔ S) ∣ S.relIndex P, and hodd : ¬ 2 ∣ S.relIndex P. The helper needs no new imports because it is pure Nat arithmetic. The remaining group-theoretic setup in each theorem is unchanged.
findings.benefit: Each theorem then shows only its group-theoretic content: the index bound by the 2-group order, and the divisibility into the odd index. The prime-power divisibility argument is written and maintained once. Future 'odd relative index plus 2-group implies containment' lemmas can reuse the helper instead of copying the by_contra block.
